author: squigsie1
quote: This has to be the worst GTA game ever. Why do I feel like I am playing The Sims with guns? The game is so slow; it feels like each mission takes at least one hour just to get to the start location. I get punished for killing people who are trying to shoot and kill me. Who wrote and made this slop? I think they need a Cyberpunk moment: sack the staff, get in people that can build the game and make improvements in the background, and actually save this game. We do not want Sims slop; totally failed the fans.
